newsitem.title: USA: Rekindled teen passion for fashion helps retailers.
newsitem.headline: Rekindled teen passion for fashion helps retailers.

text.p: For teenage girls, "grunge" is a thing of the past and its once again "cool" to be dressed up, which is very good news for some teen-oriented retailers, according to the cover story of this week's Barron's.

The stocks of retailers such as Wet Seal Inc, Pacific Sunwear of California Inc, and Gadzooks Inc were among the market's hottest performers in 1996's first nine months, before faltering in the fourth quarter due to sluggish holiday sales.
But Wall Street's bargain-hunters, lured by sharply lower valuations, are returning quickly to the "teen-scene" according to Barron's.

The rekindled passion for fashion has breathed new life into the whole juniors market, Barron's said. In fact, in the past 10 days, analysts have raised their fiscal fourth-quarter and full-year fiscal 1998 estimates for a number of teen retailers.
